titulo: Belkin’s first trackers come ready to attach to your gear.
cuerpo: After selling accessories for attaching Apple's AirTags to everything from keys to backpacks, Belkin is introducing its own trackers that work with either Apple's Find My or Google's Find Hub tracking networks.
